summary: Addendum v4.3 §1 Phase 2 verified. Backend: 15/15 PASS in new /app/backend/tests/test_sandbox_phase2.py covering: GET /api/sandbox/templates (all 8 sectors present with correct polished template_ids — saas→saas_growth, logistics→logistics_panafrican, healthcare→healthcare_provider, manufacturing→manufacturing_industrial, retail→retail_multicategory, real_estate→real_estate_developer, financial_services→banking_midcap, other→generic_diversified; is_polished=true for 7, false for other). POST /api/sandbox/generate for each of the 6 new sectors resolves to the polished template (NOT generic), produces >=4 signals with sector-specific keywords in headlines (saas:'net revenue retention', logistics:'ERP', healthcare:'readmission', manufacturing:'hedg', retail:'Shrinkage', real_estate:'Coast Gardens'), and {company_name}/{currency}/{regulator} substitutions render cleanly (no residual curly-brace placeholders leak into document text). POST /api/sandbox/contexts/{cid}/capture-email stores lowercased email on context.sandbox_metadata.prospect_email (verified via /auth/me), rejects invalid email format (422), and returns 404 for non-existent/non-sandbox context. POST /api/sandbox/convert: (a) flips executive-role context from 'sandbox' to 'executive_personal' with converted_at stamped and expires_at/read_only_until/hard_delete_at unset; (b) flips NED-role context to 'ned_personal'; (c) returns 409 when email already exists (bramuel@syni.ai); (d) returns 400 when non-sandbox account calls it; (e) keep_sandbox=false actually deletes context + all sandbox artefacts and the converted user has zero sandbox contexts afterward. Regression: test_sprint6 + test_iter11_speaking_notes + test_iter12_shares_home (26 tests) all PASS unchanged. Frontend arc verified live: /sandbox → fill Q1-Q4 with TEST_ConvertFE + Financial services + NED + East Africa → /sandbox/generating/<id> → /app with sandbox-banner present and exact spec copy → click sandbox-banner-convert → /signup?from_sandbox=<cid> renders the conversion UI with overline 'STEP 1 OF 1 · TURN YOUR SANDBOX INTO AN ACCOUNT', heading 'Keep exploring — for real.', signup-keep-sandbox checkbox (default-checked with TEST_ConvertFE name), and 'Finish setup' CTA — all testids/copy match spec. rca of the issue: Dropdown issue RCA: the SelectContent uses Radix's SelectPrimitive which positions 'popper' with side='bottom' — verified, the panel DOES render below the trigger. But the listbox viewport default scrollTop is whatever Radix sets based on the currently-selected item or the internal scroll restoration logic, and with 8 items at roughly 32px each the visible window starts at item[1]='SaaS / Technology'. The fix requires EITHER (a) onOpenAutoFocus/ref-based scrollTop=0 on the Radix Viewport, (b) setting the SelectContent max-height to accommodate all 8 items without scroll (about 256px), or (c) moving Financial services with an explicit <SelectItem value='financial_services' autoFocus>. Option (b) is the simplest and matches the 'this is the polished template — show it first' intent.
